name: ThunderBolt
summary: In ThunderBolt, you pilot a jet fighter through a collapsing space-time continuum after a failed Chronoclasm experiment. As Earth and Proxima battle over temporal weapons, you're caught in a war spanning centuries – fighting enemies from past and future alike. This side-scrolling shooter challenges you to fly left to right without getting destroyed, using a standard unlimited shot and a powerful screen-clearing special attack. Every hit or wall collision drains fuel, forcing you to balance aggression with precision. With tight corridors and time-warping chaos, survival demands skill and sharp reflexes.
